scope: Post-P7 deterministic design amendments for the first bug-fix wave. Phase receipts, original coverage check IDs and private baseline archive fingerprints remain historical and unchanged.

revisions.change: A group has one frame and one label when its combined visible-member bounds preserve 24px padding and 8px clearance from nonmembers. Otherwise the existing segmented fallback remains. The label follows the topmost visible member.

cases: one group spanning a root and three branches has one padded frame
a clear cross-branch group merges even when other visible Agents are not members
a combined group frame requires at least 8px clearance from nonmembers
one real four-member Group renders one frame through resizing, card growth and folding

revisions.evidenceScope: The browser regression uses actual Core Group and DashboardProjector data with four nodes and real React/Chrome measurements, resize, growth, folding and group selection. It is a local deterministic fixture with no external model requests. These results do not replace P6/P7 historical verification or claim a new business-model run. Remote CI for the amended PR remains a separate result.

revisions.change: Explicit wait checks every unread Mailbox source, including User and System assignment status updates. Predicate, deadline, priority, reentry and ordinary standby notification paths retain their existing contracts. No new waiting API is introduced.

cases: an existing unread system message can match an explicit wait without reading its body
a later system match preserves unrelated messages and cancels only its own deadline
an existing unread user message can match an explicit wait without reading its body
a later user match preserves unrelated messages and cancels only its own deadline
System standby notifications and unrelated high User messages retain their ordinary scheduling
a reentrant User arrival during a System predicate is matched in the same atomic scan
existing AssignmentService System result notifications complete native flow_wait
later AssignmentService System result notifications complete native flow_wait
regressions.scope: Real prepare, native flow_submit with explicit continuingChildren, trusted System inbox notification, native flow_wait matched/registered, concludeTurn and resumed native execution. The LLM adapter is deterministic.

ciSupplement.change: After final React unmount, assert every Client is disposed and every issued SSE request signal is aborted. Then wait up to 5 seconds for server response close and require zero remaining connections; failures list remaining SSE paths.
ciSupplement.causeStatus: The prior CI timeout is not reproduced locally. These results establish neither a product race nor a pure timeout cause. Remote CI for this amended source remains pending.
